title: The New Heaven and the New Earth, The New Jerusalem

questions.question: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the ____ was no more.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:1 (ESV): "Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more."

questions.question: And I saw the holy city, new ____, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:2 (ESV): "And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband."

questions.question: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Behold, the dwelling place of God is with ____. He will dwell with them, and they will be his people..."
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:3 (ESV): "And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, 'Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man. He will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.'"

questions.question: He will wipe away every ____ from their eyes, and ____ shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore...
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:4 (ESV): "He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore, for the former things have passed away."

questions.question: And he who was seated on the throne said, "Behold, I am making all things ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:5 (ESV): "And he who was seated on the throne said, 'Behold, I am making all things new.' Also he said, 'Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.'"

questions.question: And he said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the ____ I will give from the spring of the water of life without payment."
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:6 (ESV): "And he said to me, 'It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will give from the spring of the water of life without payment.'"

questions.question: But as for the cowardly, the faithless, the detestable, as for murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all ____, their portion will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur...
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:8 (ESV): "But as for the cowardly, the faithless, the detestable, as for murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their portion will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death."

questions.question: Then came one of the seven angels... and spoke to me, saying, "Come, I will show you the Bride, the wife of the ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:9 (ESV): "Then came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues and spoke to me, saying, 'Come, I will show you the Bride, the wife of the Lamb.'"

questions.question: It had a great, high wall, with twelve ____, and at the ____ twelve angels, and on the ____ the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel were inscribed—
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:12 (ESV): "It had a great, high wall, with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and on the gates the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel were inscribed—"

questions.question: And the wall of the city had twelve ____, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:14 (ESV): "And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb."

questions.question: The city lies foursquare, its ____ the same as its width. And he measured the city with his rod, 12,000 stadia. Its ____ and width and height are equal.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:16 (ESV): "The city lies foursquare, its length the same as its width. And he measured the city with his rod, 12,000 stadia. Its length and width and height are equal."

questions.question: And the twelve gates were twelve ____, each of the gates made of a single ____, and the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:21 (ESV): "And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, each of the gates made of a single pearl, and the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass."

questions.question: And I saw no ____ in the city, for its ____ is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:22 (ESV): "And I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb."

questions.question: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and its lamp is the ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:23 (ESV): "And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and its lamp is the Lamb."

questions.question: But nothing ____ will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:27 (ESV): "But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is detestable or false, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life."

key_verse_text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man. He will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore, for the former things have passed away."
